text:
nina-partnerships: Quick check-in for the cloud listing preflight. We have three outstanding things: Azure private-offer metadata, cross-cloud SKU metering, and export-control / AML signoff. Who can drive each?
leo-cloud-ops: I can own Azure private-offer wiring + publisher manifest. Need the offer id format and the landing page URL (will be link in the offer). Also want to confirm publisher SSO mapping for marketplace testing accounts.
emma-legal: I'll handle export-control and AML disclosure language. Quick note: for some models/data usages we need to add a short export-control checkbox on the offer page. I'll draft language but need product input on the gating questions.
zhou-product: I'll define the gating questions and UX copy. Proposal: single checkbox for "I confirm this deployment will not be used for sanctioned activities" + link to terms. We should also surface deployment-region selector in the listing to map entitlements.
kevin-eng: For metering we need unique SKU per billing-meter combination. Suggest we do unified product SKU with meter_variants: [{"cloud":"aws","meter":"tokens"},{"cloud":"azure","meter":"requests"}] so finance can map. Example manifest snippet: ```json
{"product_sku":"RW-INF-PUB-001","meters":[{"cloud":"aws","meter_id":"tokens_v1"},{"cloud":"gcp","meter_id":"tokens_v1"},{"cloud":"azure","meter_id":"requests_v2"}],"trial_days":14}
```This keeps a single SKU in billing but explicit meter mapping.
nina-partnerships: Kevin 94 solid. Emma: do we need different trial language per-cloud? Some marketplaces force specific trial semantics.
emma-legal: Right. Azure private offers allow custom trial terms in the offer metadata; AWS tends to show "Free trial" but the backend enforcement is ours. Keep canonical contract term in our EULA, and add per-cloud disclaimer in the listing metadata. I'll produce two short blurbs: one for AWS/GCP, one for Azure private.
leo-cloud-ops: Ops question: imaging and artifact sizes. Marketplace tile upload caps differ across clouds. We need hero images: 1024x300 (AWS), 900x600 (GCP), and 1024x768 (Azure). Can Marketing confirm resizes? @market-bot any asset pack status?
market-bot: asset-upload: 5 assets uploaded to drive/marketplace/480111. Missing: Azure hero 1024x768.
zhou-product: We'll fallback to responsive crop if not provided, but prefer the exact sizes. Also we need a short 200-250 word description and a 1-line elevator pitch for each cloud page (some stores show different excerpts).
kevin-eng: Integration test plan: smoke endpoints for marketplace-auth, meter-reporting, and trial-enablement. I'll add a pipeline job named marketplace-e2e that posts sample usage & validates billing events. Minimal test payload: ```json
{"request_id":"test-123","cloud":"aws","sku":"RW-INF-PUB-001","tokens":120}
``` 
emma-legal: Also reminder: include a third-party license summary for bundled libs + an OSS notice for the listing. Kevin: point me to the generated licenses.txt when you have it.
nina-partnerships: Timeline: ops (leo) to share publisher account/offer IDs by Tue; product (zhou) final UX copy by Wed; legal (emma) EOD Tue for export/AML + OSS blurb; eng (kevin) CI job + manifest template by Wed. Marketing to deliver final image pack by Thu.
leo-cloud-ops: I'll DM the publisher IDs. I'll also provision a sandbox private-offer in Azure and post the offer GUID here when done.
kevin-eng: I'll open the PR with CI job and add a script to generate licenses summary (scripts/generate_license_summary.sh).
market-bot: reminder: marketplace launch calendar slot requested for next-week Wednesday.
nina-partnerships: Great. If anyone hits a blocker ping me. We'll aim to keep trial at 14d for parity with support guidance. :rocket:
